# ADR-NNNN: <title — state the decision or constraint concretely>

- Status: Proposed | Accepted | Superseded by ADR-….
- Date: YYYY-MM-DD

## Context

The forces and constraints that make this decision necessary — what presses, and what a reader needs to understand the choice.

## Decision

What is decided, stated so a reader can act on it.
Use numbered sub-decisions (D1, D2, …) when the decision has parts.

## Consequences

What becomes easier and what becomes harder — the positive outcomes, the negative ones and their risks, and how reversible the decision is.
